title: Margining and risk management
objectives: Describe SPAN, exposure and extreme loss margins.
body_md:
## Margin components

| Component | Purpose |
|---|---|
| **SPAN margin** | Largest likely one-day loss across a risk-scenario grid |
| **Exposure margin** | Extra buffer over SPAN |
| **Extreme loss margin** | Covers unusual moves |
| **Premium margin** | Buyers pay the premium upfront; no margin on long options |
| **MTM** | Daily settlement of losses |

## Margins for sellers

Option sellers pay SPAN plus exposure margin. Calendar and hedged positions earn **margin benefit**.

## Limits

- **Position limits** per client, member and market-wide.
- **Market-wide position limit (MWPL)** for stocks: if open interest nears the limit, new positions are restricted (ban period).
- **Intraday and peak margin** rules cut leverage; margins must be collected upfront.

## Client risk

- Risk disclosure and **suitability** for derivatives clients.
- Educate clients that **leverage can multiply losses**.
- Use **stop-loss** discipline; avoid selling uncovered options without capacity.

> **Exam tip:** SPAN approximates a worst one-day loss.
example: A stock reaches 95% of its MWPL and enters the ban period: only positions that reduce open interest are allowed.
